reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

units.title: 故事木偶的收纳与修补

materials.title: Reading Puppet 042A
materials.text: The story puppet lives in a soft bag. Take it out with clean hands. Hold its body, not its long ears. Tell the teacher if a button comes loose. Put it back in the bag after the story.

questions.prompt: You want to take out the puppet. Say: ____
options: I will clean my hands first.
I will pull its ears hard.
I will put it in a wet box.
questions.explanation: A取前手干净；B拉耳违背拿身；C湿盒不属软袋。

questions.prompt: A friend holds the puppet by one ear. Say: ____
questions.explanation: B提醒拿身体；A数扣、C关窗不纠正拿法。

questions.prompt: A button is loose. Say: ____
questions.explanation: C报告老师；A扯下、B藏起均非求修。

questions.prompt: The story is over. Say: ____
options: I will put the puppet back in its bag.
I will leave it on the floor.
I will hang it by its ears.
questions.explanation: A故事后回软袋；B地上、C吊耳均不合收纳。

questions.prompt: A friend asks where the puppet belongs. Say: ____
questions.explanation: C软袋为住处；A水槽、B操场栏均不是存放点。

materials.title: Queue Tickets 042B
materials.text: At the beanbag game, take one number ticket. Wait until your number is called. Throw three beanbags, then give them to the helper. Keep behind the line when someone else throws. Put your used ticket in the box.

questions.prompt: You want a turn. Ask: ____
options: May I take all the tickets?
May I stand in front of the thrower?
questions.explanation: A一张号码票；B全拿、C站投者前均违反轮次要求。

questions.prompt: Your number has not been called. Say: ____
options: I will take another child’s ticket.
questions.explanation: B未叫号等候；A抢投、C拿他票不合规则。

questions.prompt: You finish three throws. Say: ____
options: I will keep all the beanbags.
I will give the beanbags to the helper.
questions.explanation: C三投后归助手；A占包、B再投十次不合轮次。

questions.prompt: Another child is throwing. Say: ____
options: I will stand beside the target.
I will stay behind the line.
I will run across the game.
questions.explanation: B等候在线后；A靶边、C横穿都违背边界。

questions.prompt: Your ticket has been used. Say: ____
options: I will put it in the ticket box.
I will give it to someone for another turn.
I will leave it on the grass.
questions.explanation: A用票入盒；B转票再轮、C草地遗留均非收票流程。

materials.title: Class Postbox 042C
materials.text: The class postbox is for kind notes. Write the reader’s name on the front. Fold the note once and put it through the slot. The teacher opens the box on Friday. If you need help today, speak to the teacher instead of waiting for Friday.

questions.prompt: You write a note for Dan. Say: ____
options: I will put my age on the front.
I will write Dan’s name on the front.
I will leave every name off.
questions.explanation: B正面写收件Dan；A年龄、C无名不能指定读者。

questions.prompt: Your note is ready. Say: ____
options: I will fold it once and post it through the slot.
I will tear it into tiny pieces.
I will leave it in my shoe.
questions.explanation: A折一次投槽；B撕碎、C鞋里均非投递。

questions.prompt: You need help with a problem today. Say: ____
options: I will wait until next Friday.
Teacher, may I speak to you now?
questions.explanation: C当天需求直接找老师；A等周五不合及时求助；B不写名不解决。

questions.prompt: A friend asks when the box opens. Say: ____
questions.explanation: A周五开；B每小时、C仅夏天非安排。

questions.prompt: A friend writes an unkind note. Say: ____
options: Write it on the door too.
Our postbox is for kind notes.
questions.explanation: C提醒友善用途；A催投、B上门写均不合要求。

materials.title: Apple Tasting 042D
materials.text: At the tasting table, the helper offers apple slices with tongs. Take one slice on a paper plate. Ask for no apple if you do not want any. Do not touch the shared slices. Put your empty plate in the paper bin.

questions.prompt: You would like one slice. Say: ____
questions.explanation: A一片礼貌请求；B整盘、C摸每片不合份额与公用规则。

questions.prompt: You do not want apple. Say: ____
options: I will take one and throw it.
No apple for me, thank you.
questions.explanation: C礼貌婉拒；A藏、B拿后扔都不表达不需要。

questions.prompt: A friend reaches for the shared slices. Say: ____
options: Please let the helper use the tongs.
Put your hand in the paper bin.
questions.explanation: B助手夹取避免触公盘；A全摸违反规则；C手入桶不解决取食。

questions.prompt: You need somewhere to put your slice. Ask: ____
options: May I put it in your pocket?
May I have a paper plate?
questions.explanation: B纸盘承装；A他人口袋、C地面不合要求。

questions.prompt: Your plate is empty. Say: ____
options: I will put it among the apple slices.
I will leave it on a chair.
I will put it in the paper bin.
questions.explanation: C空盘入纸桶；A混公盘、B椅上遗留均非处理点。

units.title: 窗边香草盆的两张标签

materials.title: Window Herbs 042E
materials.text: Sana grows mint and basil in two pots. The mint pot has a blue label. The basil pot has a white label. Both pots stand by the kitchen window. Sana waters them in the morning. On Sunday, her dad waters them because she visits her cousin. She takes no plants with her.

questions.prompt: Sana grows two kinds of herbs.
questions.explanation: A True薄荷与罗勒两类；B False否定明确分类。

questions.prompt: The mint label is white.
questions.explanation: B False，薄荷蓝标签，罗勒白；A True串标签。

questions.prompt: The pots are beside the kitchen window.
questions.explanation: A True位置一致；B False否定地点。

questions.prompt: Sana’s dad waters the pots on Sunday.
questions.explanation: A True周日父亲代浇；B False否定分工。

questions.prompt: Sana takes the mint pot to her cousin.
questions.explanation: B False，明确不带任何植物；A True违背携物说明。

units.title: 饼干盒里分给邻居的饼干

materials.title: Biscuit Tin 042F
materials.text: There are eight biscuits in a tin. Leo puts three in a small bag for his neighbour. He leaves five in the tin. The small bag is on the kitchen chair. Leo’s mother takes it next door. Leo stays home and washes the plate. The tin stays on the shelf.

questions.prompt: There are eight biscuits at the start.
questions.explanation: A True起初八块；B False否定数量。

questions.prompt: Leo leaves three biscuits in the tin.
questions.explanation: B False，三块入袋，五块留盒；A True串分配。

questions.prompt: The bag is for Leo’s neighbour.
questions.explanation: A True收件邻居；B False否定对象。

questions.prompt: Leo takes the bag next door himself.
questions.explanation: B False，母亲送，Leo在家洗盘；A True对调人物。

questions.prompt: The tin stays under the chair.
questions.explanation: B False，盒在架上，椅上是袋；A True串容器位置。

units.title: 整理橱柜时的五个问答

materials.title: Cupboard Help 042G
materials.text: Choose the reply that best answers each question while tidying a classroom cupboard.

questions.prompt: Where do these cups go?
questions.explanation: B归放地点；A大小、C数量不答where。

questions.prompt: How many boxes are empty?
questions.explanation: A回答数量；B颜色、C位置非how many。

questions.prompt: Whose bag is behind the door?
questions.explanation: C归属老师；A颜色、B内容不答whose。

questions.prompt: Can you hold this box for me?
options: Yes. Is this a good place to hold it?
questions.explanation: A接受帮拿并确认位置；B材质、C门数不回应请求。

questions.prompt: Are these plates clean?
questions.explanation: A回答清洁与否；B位置、C用途不答状态。

materials.title: Insect Room 042H
materials.text: Choose the best reply to each question in a written conversation at an insect room.

questions.prompt: What can you see in this tank?
questions.explanation: A看到的对象；B地点、C时间不答what。

questions.prompt: Is it on the leaf?
options: No, it is on the branch.
questions.explanation: B回应是否在叶上并纠正位置；A颜色、C腿数不答位置判断。

questions.prompt: Who looks after the insects?
questions.explanation: C照料者；A食物、B房间大小不答who。

questions.prompt: Can we tap the glass?
questions.explanation: B许可否定并提示安静；A惊醒昆虫不是恰当参观行为；C透明度不答可否。

questions.prompt: When does the room close?
questions.explanation: A关门时间；B工具、C位置不答when。

units.title: 蜡笔折断后的借用对话

materials.title: Broken Crayon Order 042I
materials.text:
Read and order this written dialogue. First line: 1. My yellow crayon has broken.
A. Thank you. I only need it for the sun.
B. Yes, here is my yellow one.
C. You are welcome. You can keep it until the sun is finished.
D. Could I borrow a yellow crayon, please?
E. That is kind. I will give it back after I colour the sun.
Choose the position of each line, from 2 to 6.

questions.prompt: What position does line A take?
questions.explanation: C第4步收到蜡笔后道谢并说明太阳用途；A第2步提出借用，B第3步递笔，D第5步延长借时，E第6步承诺归还。

questions.prompt: What position does line B take?
questions.explanation: B第3步回答借笔请求并递笔；A第2步应先问借，C第4步道谢说明用途，D第5步许可用到画完，E第6步承诺。

questions.prompt: What position does line C take?
questions.explanation: D第5步You are welcome回应道谢并延长到太阳画完；A第2步请求，B第3步给笔，C第4步说明用途，E第6步回应延长。

questions.prompt: What position does line D take?
questions.explanation: A第2步断笔后请求借黄笔；B第3步才给笔，C第4步才道谢，D第5步再许可，E第6步最后承诺。

questions.prompt: What position does line E take?
questions.explanation: E第6步That is kind回应可留到太阳完成的许可并承诺归还；A第2、B第3、C第4、D第5步是先前请求、递交、道谢和许可。

units.title: 水洒到拼图后的清理对话

materials.title: Spill Clean Order 042J
materials.text:
Order the written dialogue. No sound or picture is needed. First line: 1. Oh no, I spilled water beside our puzzle!
A. Good. The dry pieces can go in the blue box now.
B. Please lift the puzzle pieces while I fetch a cloth.
C. All the dry pieces are in the box. Let us wipe the table next.
D. Here is the cloth. Are the pieces dry?
E. Yes, I lifted them quickly, so they are dry.
Choose each line’s position from 2 to 6.

questions.prompt: What position does line A take?
questions.explanation: D第5步确认干燥后才让干片入蓝盒；A第2步先提抬起，B第3步取布返回问干否，C第4步回答，E第6步报告入盒。

questions.prompt: What position does line B take?
questions.explanation: A第2步洒水后分工抬片取布；B第3步带布返回，C第4步确认干，D第5步入盒，E第6步擦桌。

questions.prompt: What position does line C take?
questions.explanation: E第6步已入盒才转下一步擦桌；A第2、B第3、C第4、D第5步依次分工、返回、答干燥、下收盒指令。

questions.prompt: What position does line D take?
questions.explanation: B第3步先前说取布，此时返回带布并问干否；A第2步分工，C第4步答问，D第5步收盒，E第6步完成后擦桌。

questions.prompt: What position does line E take?
questions.explanation: C第4步Yes回答Are the pieces dry并解释抬得快；A第2步尚未取布，B第3步提问，D第5步收片，E第6步报告完成。

units.title: 运动日简讯里的五个动作词

materials.title: Weather Actions Bank 042K
materials.text:
Read the complete note. Use each word in the bank once. Bank: A. bring B. wait C. close D. wear E. drink
Our outdoor sports morning may be cool. Please ____1____ your trainers and a light jacket. Please ____2____ your own water bottle from home. After running, ____3____ some water from that bottle. If the teacher is still setting out cones, ____4____ behind the gate until she calls you. When the last pupil comes through, please ____5____ the gate so the ball cannot roll out.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: D wear穿戴运动鞋外套；A bring只表示带来不表达已穿戴，B等待、C关、E喝均不搭此宾语。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: A bring从家带来自己的瓶子；B等待、C关闭不表达从家携来，D穿戴瓶、E喝瓶均不合。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: E drink喝瓶中水；A带来不表达跑后饮用，B等待、C关闭、D穿戴均不搭some water的所需动作。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: B wait与until she calls构成等候；A带来、C关闭、D穿戴、E饮用均不合无宾语及直到叫号的语意。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: C close关门防球滚出；A带来不能与the gate及所述目的自然对应，B等待、D穿戴、E喝不搭门。

units.title: 读书介绍里的五个疑问词

materials.title: Book Report Bank 042L
materials.text:
Complete the written interview using each question word once. Bank: A. When B. Who C. Why D. Where E. How
Nora is speaking about a book she borrowed.
1. ____ wrote the book? — A writer called Ada Bell.
2. ____ did you borrow it? — At the town library.
3. ____ did you choose it? — Because I enjoy stories about ships.
4. ____ did you finish it? — Last night.
5. ____ did you carry all the books home? — In a bag, on my back.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: B Who问作者人；A时间、C原因、D地点、E方式均不由作家姓名回答。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: D Where问借书地点，town library回应；A时间、B人、C原因、E方式均非该答句信息。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C Why由Because原因回应；A时间、B人、D地点、E方式不对应喜欢船故事的缘由。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: A When由Last night时间回答；B人物、C原因、D地点、E方式都不合该短答。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: E How问携带方式，背包背回；A时间、B人物、C原因、D地点均不对应方式答句。

materials.title: Weather Window 042M
materials.text: The class checks the weather at the same window every day. One pupil looks outside at nine, and another writes the result on the chart. They record sunshine, cloud or rain. They do not record temperature because they have no thermometer. On Friday, the class compares all five days. This week, Monday and Thursday were rainy; the other three days were sunny.

questions.prompt: The weather is checked at nine.
questions.explanation: A True时间明示；B False否定固定观察时刻。

questions.prompt: The class records the temperature each day.
questions.explanation: B False，无温度计所以不记录；A True与明确否定冲突。

questions.prompt: Two pupils have different jobs in the daily check.
questions.explanation: A True一人看一人写；B False否定分工。

questions.prompt: It rained on Monday and Thursday this week.
questions.explanation: A True两天与原句一致；B False否定日期。

questions.prompt: There were two sunny days this week.
questions.explanation: B False，其余三天晴；A True把晴天数量写少。

materials.title: New Pupil Route 042N
materials.text: From the front entrance, walk past the office and turn right at the notice board. Room 6 is the second door on the left. New pupils meet there at 8:45, before lessons begin at nine. Bring a pencil; the school will provide a notebook. Parents may walk to Room 6 with pupils but must leave before lessons start.

questions.prompt: Pupils turn left at the notice board.
questions.explanation: B False，应右转；A True颠倒方向。

questions.prompt: Room 6 is the second door on the left.
questions.explanation: A True门序方向一致；B False否定路线。

questions.prompt: The meeting starts after the nine o’clock lessons begin.
questions.explanation: B False，8:45集合在9点上课前；A True颠倒先后。

questions.prompt: New pupils should bring a pencil.
questions.explanation: A True自带铅笔；B False否定物品要求。

questions.prompt: Parents can stay through the lessons.
questions.explanation: B False，课前必须离开；A True扩大陪同许可。

units.title: 种子交换会的袋子标记

materials.title: Seed Exchange 042O
materials.text: At the seed exchange, each packet must show the plant name and the month the seeds were collected. Bring dry seeds in paper packets, not plastic bags. You can swap one packet for one packet. Seeds from unknown plants are not accepted. A volunteer checks the labels at the entrance before packets reach the swap table.

questions.prompt: What information is needed on a packet?
questions.explanation: B植物名与采种月份；A仅颜色、C鞋码不合标记要求。

questions.prompt: Which container should be used?
questions.explanation: A纸袋且种子干燥；B明示非塑料；C敞口杯不是要求容器。

questions.prompt: How many packets can be received for one packet?
options: As many as fit in a bag.
questions.explanation: C一换一；A十包、B不限数量违背比例。

questions.prompt: Which seeds will be refused?
questions.explanation: B未知植物种子不接收；A、C符合已述条件。

questions.prompt: When are labels checked?
options: At the entrance before the table.
questions.explanation: C入口先查再上交换桌；A结束后、B仅家中均非流程。

materials.title: School Photo Day 042P
materials.text: Class photos are on Monday. Each class goes to the hall when its teacher is called. Leave coats in the classroom, but wear the school jumper. A pupil who is absent on Monday may have an individual photo on Thursday. There will be no second class group photo. Families can order copies after seeing the sample online.

questions.prompt: When does a class go to the hall?
options: At the end of every lesson.
questions.explanation: C等老师被叫再去；A个人就绪、B每节下课均非信号。

questions.prompt: What should pupils leave in the classroom?
questions.explanation: A材料明示外套留教室；B校毛衣须穿；C水瓶不属本通知指定留下的物品。

questions.prompt: What is available on Thursday for an absent pupil?
options: A second group photo for parents.
questions.explanation: B周四提供缺席学生个人补拍；A明确无再次全班照；C家长合照不在安排内。

questions.prompt: When can families order copies?
questions.explanation: C先看线上样张再订；A未拍前、B仅上课时不合条件。

questions.prompt: Will another class group photo be taken?
options: No, only individual catch-up photos are offered.
Yes, for every absent pupil separately as a full class.
questions.explanation: B明确无二次合照只个人补拍；A每周、C每缺一人全班重拍均违反安排。

materials.title: Category School Bag 042Q
materials.text: Choose the category that contains all three words in each question. Categories: A. school subjects B. rooms C. clothes D. food E. transport. Each question can be answered from the words alone; no picture is needed.

questions.prompt: Which category contains kitchen, bedroom and bathroom?
questions.explanation: B都是房间；A学科、C衣物、D食物、E交通工具均不包含这三种空间。

questions.prompt: Which category contains tram, train and ferry?
questions.explanation: E有轨电车、火车、渡船皆交通工具；A学科、B房间、C衣物、D食物不合。

questions.prompt: Which category contains scarf, jacket and sock?
questions.explanation: C围巾夹克袜皆衣物；A学科、B房间、D食物、E交通工具均非所属。

questions.prompt: Which category contains maths, science and history?
questions.explanation: A数学科学历史为学校学科；B房间、C衣物、D食物、E交通工具不合。

questions.prompt: Which category contains bread, cheese and noodles?
questions.explanation: D面包奶酪面条为食物；A学科、B房间、C衣物、E交通工具不合。

materials.title: Cloth Banner Cloze 042R
materials.text:
Read the whole passage and choose one answer for each of the six gaps.
Our class made a cloth banner for the sports field. We wanted to use it again, so we chose cloth ____1____ paper. First, we painted large letters and left the banner flat until the paint was ____2____. On the first windy day, the bottom edge lifted and hid the words. We added small loops along that edge and tied them to the fence. This kept the banner ____3____ place. We checked that the loops were not so tight that the cloth could tear. Before taking the banner down, we photographed it ____4____ the next class could see how to attach it. After the event, we washed it and waited for it to dry ____5____ folding it. It is now stored in a box with a label ____6____ “Sports banner”.

questions.prompt: Choose the answer for gap 1.
questions.explanation: B instead of表示以可重复用的布替代纸；A because of把纸当选布原因不合对比；C next to仅相邻不表达材料替换。

questions.prompt: Choose the answer for gap 2.
questions.explanation: A dry表示颜料晾干后适合后续装挂；B wet仍湿、C sticky仍粘均未达到本段等待晾干的结束状态。

questions.prompt: Choose the answer for gap 3.
questions.explanation: C in place固定短语表示在原位；A at place、B on place不组成此搭配。

questions.prompt: Choose the answer for gap 4.
questions.explanation: A so that引出拍照供后班参考的目的；B although让步、C unless条件不合因果用途。

questions.prompt: Choose the answer for gap 5.
questions.explanation: A before先晾干再折；B among需复数群体不接此动名词事件；C during不直接接folding it表达此先后。

questions.prompt: Choose the answer for gap 6.
questions.explanation: C label saying为标签上写着的分词修饰；A writes、B wrote是限定动词，不能直接在with a label后组成此修饰结构。
